Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve. Asset type: production character sprite atlas for the Japanese top-down pixel RPG Pachi Monsters. Image 1 is the edit target and identity/layout reference. Redraw its SAME male explorer into exceptionally polished high-detail handcrafted PIXEL ART, with crisp small square pixel clusters, stepped silhouettes, restrained material-specific dithering, precise readable eyes, fabric seams, coat embroidery, backpack straps and buckles, scarf folds, cap stitching and boot laces. Rich full color; clear dark outlines and warm highlights/cool shadows; no airbrushing or blur. Preserve his ochre cap, brown tousled hair, teal long coat with cream piping and gold buttons, rust scarf, olive backpack, dark trousers and brown boots. Friendly young adventurer, SAME recognizable proportions and design.

STRICT ATLAS: exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, 12 separate full-body sprites, no extra figures. Left to right columns: front/down facing viewer; profile facing LEFT; profile facing RIGHT; back/up facing away. Top to bottom rows: standing idle; walking with left leg forward; walking with right leg forward. The walking poses must be distinct coherent alternating gait, same height/scale/baseline in every cell. Each full silhouette including cap, hands, boots and backpack must fit entirely inside its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters; centered horizontally in each cell. Straight orthographic slight top-down classic JRPG view, never isometric. Keep all faces, hands and feet well formed. Output a large square atlas around 2048 px so each sprite has fine intentional pixel detail. Actual transparent background everywhere outside sprites; no checkerboard, labels, text, grid lines, symbols, extra props, glow, shadow puddles or scenery. This will be automatically sliced into four equal columns and three equal rows.
